_comment: Machine-readable DoD budget exhibits screened by extract.py. Amounts in these exhibits are in thousands of dollars. Verify URLs each budget cycle: the Comptroller site moved from comptroller.defense.gov to comptroller.war.gov in 2025. 'local' is where --fetch saves the file and --local reads it; set 'sha256' once a copy is committed so later runs verify it.
